passages.text: I have a small cup. It is blue. I drink milk from it.
At home, Mia feeds her fish. The fish is red. It swims in a bowl.
This bus is yellow. It stops near my house. I take it to school.
Grandma has a garden. She plants flowers there. She waters the garden every day.
A baby cat is under the table. The cat is hungry. I give it food.
Every morning, Jo puts on his shoes. He takes his bag. He walks to school.
At lunch, three friends sit at one table. They share bread and fruit. They talk and laugh.
There is a small shop near our school. It sells bread, milk, and fruit. Children buy snacks there.
Sara has a little plant. She puts it near the window. Every day, she gives it water. The plant grows.
First, wash your hands. Then take some bread. Put cheese on it. Your snack is ready.
Maya has a water bottle. She takes it to school. She drinks from it after sports. She puts more water in it at lunch.
The school library opens in the morning. Students read books there. Some students do homework there. The room is quiet.
Dad and I make dinner. Dad cooks rice. I wash the tomatoes. We put the food on the table and eat together.
The park has trees and a pond. Ducks swim in the pond. Children sit under the trees. Families like this park.
Rafi has two small dogs. One dog is white, and one is black. The dogs play in the yard. Rafi gives them food and water.
It is raining today. Nia stays inside. She draws a house. She reads a book. She plays a game with Dad. Nia has a good day.
A new girl comes to class. She does not have a pencil. Ida gives her one. At lunch, Ida sits with her. They talk and smile.
Our class has a small garden. We plant seeds. We give the plants water. We take away old leaves. Now there are many green plants.
Bima and Sari go to the market. They buy apples and eggs. They carry the food home. They put it in the kitchen. Then they make lunch.
Some students walk to school. Some ride bikes. Some take the bus. They all come to the same school. They come in different ways.
